rows.note: Use this for the directions supplied with a product or service, especially a manual.

example.english: This instruction manual is very clear.
example.traditional: 呢本說明書寫得好清楚。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syut3 ming4 syu1 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for teaching or educational instruction.

example.english: The instruction in this lesson is easy to understand.
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 gaau3 hok6 hou2 ji6 ming4

rows.note: Use this for information or directions given to guide someone, rather than for a product manual or an authoritative command.

example.english: Just follow the instruction and you will be fine.
example.traditional: 你跟住張指示做就得喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 gan1 zyu6 zoeng1 zi2 si6 zou6 zau6 dak1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the instruction is an authoritative order or command.

example.english: They received the instruction from their boss and set off immediately.
example.traditional: 佢收到上司嘅命令，即刻出發。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sau1 dou2 soeng6 si1 ge3 ming6 ling6 zik1 hak1 ceot1 faat3
